blind.B1: Questionable but plausible: the abstract says mechanical load was increased by 'inducing high-force contractions' in young and aged mice; GSE269698 has unilateral electrically stimulated eccentric contractions (Stim) vs contralateral non-stimulated TA, aged vehicle, 6 vs 6. The abstract does not say these muscles were sequenced (could be qPCR); the DEX arms belong to other papers. Exercise-like factor = stim/contractions protocol.
blind.B2: Aged vehicle Stim vs Non-Stim TA; n=6 each by GEO; abstract gives no n.
blind.B3: Yes likely: unilateral design means both legs of one mouse. Candidate keys in packet A: replicate suffix of title/description (OVN1/OVS1), the derived 'subject' m1-m6, each once per level and linking 12/12. Not stated per sample in GEO.
blind.B5: Abstract gives no threshold or counts.

checks.evidence: Ownership confidence medium: abstract does not say contraction data were sequenced.

Pairing inferred from replicate number; GEO overall_design says aged vehicle n=4 mice but 6 pairs deposited; residual correlation of OVNk-OVSk -0.49..0.26 shows no support. Paired primary gives 1 DEG, unpaired sensitivity 104 DEG (95 up/9 down).
checks.fix: Do not take the paired 1-DEG count as the headline. Report both fits side by side, label the mouse key as an unverified assumption, and ask the authors/GEO whether OVN k and OVS k are the same mouse (aged vehicle has 4 mice for 6 pairs).

checks.evidence: Paper silent on joint vs pairwise; result depends strongly on pairing (1 vs 104).

human_items: Is aged OVNk/OVSk really one mouse? GEO says n=4 mice for 6 deposited pairs; the data show no within-pair correlation. Primary (paired) 1 DEG vs unpaired 104 DEG cannot be settled from the files.
Open policy item: a paired model on an unsupported key may be less valid than an unpaired one; decide which to report as primary.
summary: 老年组：配对依据仅为重复编号，而GEO写明老年vehicle只有4只小鼠却有6对样本，配对表达相关性也不支持（-0.49~0.26），因此配对结果（1个DEG）与非配对（104个DEG）差异巨大，无法由文件判定，需人工确认。其余决策（分组、方向、阈值、矩阵方法）与摘要一致。
